entities.name: Erich Abraham
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Erich Abraham was a general in the Wehrmacht of Nazi Germany who commanded the 76th Infantry Division then the LXIII Corps on the Western Front during World War II. He was also a recipient of the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross with Oak Leaves.
